chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from 'Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Mu'awiyah ibn 'Ammar, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
When you reach al-Rawha' before al-Radm, and overlook al-Abtah, then raise your voice in the talbiyah until you come to Mina.

key_terms.التَّلْبِيَةِ: The hajj invocation beginning with labbayka, recited by the pilgrim in ihram.
key_terms.الرَّدْمِ: A location or landmark mentioned as a boundary point before which one reaches al-Rawha'.
key_terms.الرَّوْحَاءِ: A known place on the route, used here as a marker for the timing of talbiyah.
key_terms.الْأَبْطَحِ: A valley or open ground that serves here as a geographical reference point.
key_terms.مِنًى: The sacred site near Makkah to which the pilgrim proceeds during hajj.

ai.seo_question: When should a muhrim raise his voice in the talbiyah during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a ruling related to hajj regarding the point at which the muhrim should raise his voice in the talbiyah. It identifies specific locations on the route and instructs continuing the talbiyah until reaching Mina.
